description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting it from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Chalk Outline triggers, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
When the Clue and Detective enter the battlefield, Skyswimmer Koi and Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, drawing Moss-Pit Skeleton from your library, and then discarding it.
Resolve the Cloakwood Swarmkeeper trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
